title: Style
description: board: the in-game leaderboard list, meant to sit where osu! draws its own. rival: only the player above you, your position and the player below, with the score gaps.

title: Orientation
description: auto: a vertical list in tall boxes, a horizontal strip in wide ones (wider than 1.6× the height).

title: Alignment
description: Vertical layouts mirror for the right side of the screen (positions on the outer edge). Horizontal strips hug the left, right or centre of their box.

title: Motion
description: full = entries slide past each other when you overtake, your row flashes amber and the passed player dims as it slides under you; your position rolls to the new number and a ▲1 / ▼1 note shows for two seconds. reduced = the slide, the roll and the note stay; no flash or dimming. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Show what osu!'s HUD shows
description: Also show your own accuracy and max combo in your row, which osu!'s own HUD already shows. Your score, your position and the gap to the next place are always shown, as are the other players' accuracy and combo.

title: Board entries
description: Most entries shown (1–16, fewer when the box runs out). When you are below them, the top entries give way to the player you are chasing, you and the player behind you.

title: Board: show accuracy
description: Accuracy of the players directly above and below you, on their second line.

title: Board: show max combo
description: Max combo of the players directly above and below you, on their second line.

title: Board: show mods
description: Mods of the players directly above and below you, and yours, on the second line.

title: Board: compact
description: One line per player: position, name and score. Your row keeps its gap line.

title: Board: show gap to next position
description: Score you need to pass the player above you, or your lead when you are first, under your score (in the strip: beside your position).
